name: orchestrate
title_zh: 你点头才派工的跨仓库并行拆单员
tagline_zh: 任务横跨多个仓库、能拆成独立小块？它先给方案，你确认后才开工人会话。不碰单行修改、只读和提问。
tagline_en: For work spanning repos or independent slices—it plans, you approve, then it spawns workers. Never for one-line.
desc_en: Orchestrate a large task with worker sessions on Promptobus. Use when work splits across repositories or independent slices, and the user asks to spawn workers, run in parallel, or watch a worker. Start workers only after explicit approval. Not for a one-line edit, a read, or a question. Isolated review of one diff without workers is solo-review.
why_zh: 把「拆解—审批—并行」做成显式流程，每个工人会话独立隔离，杜绝未经确认就乱开线程的失控感。
why_en: Makes split-approve-parallel an explicit pipeline with isolated worker sessions—no rogue threads before you say go.
limit_zh: 只认可拆分的多仓库任务；单文件改动、纯查询、单个 diff 的独立评审会直接拒绝，且必须等用户明确批准才启动工人。
limit_en: Only multi-repo splittable tasks; rejects one-line edits, reads, solo diff reviews. Requires explicit user approval before spawning workers.
title_en: Parallel task splitter that waits for your go
